adjudication_rationale: The Repair SET LOCAL brackets, the step's SET LOCAL pair and the ROLLBACK TO / RELEASE savepoint exits manage connection transaction state, which pg::PgTxn already owns by RAII. An exception rolls back every SET LOCAL and savepoint, and every non-success exit either rolls back to the savepoint or returns Abandoned so the caller never commits. The success-path restore is control flow whose result chooses the outcome, and a destructor cannot return it. A scope guard adds no safety on any path. The exception holds only while every call site runs under a PgTxn (all three do, in an anonymous namespace). The same bracket pattern predates this diff in PR A/B1. Deciding line: ~PgTxn at pg_raii.hpp:135-138.
